title: Au/Ag nanoparticle synthesis
subtitle: Size and size distribution from reaction conditions, checked against 7 published sweeps; MD/DFT used where the MD/DFT gate says it pays off.

problem.text: Colloidal gold nanoparticles around 8 nm with a narrow size distribution, made by citrate or seeded citrate reduction in water, for UV-Vis and DLS verification on the robot.

stages.summary: Au near 8 nm, SD <= 1.5 nm; knobs: reductant:precursor ratio, temperature, volume

decisions.why: precursor, reductant, capping, ratios, concentrations, T, pH/base, seeds, injections, time

decisions.a: size mean, SD/CV, LSPR, DLS z-average/PDI
decisions.why: all measurable on the robot by UV-Vis and DLS
targets are known quantities; knobs are canonical keys

stages.summary: 260 recipes from the LeMat-Synth dump; 68 in the Au/Ag family; only 11 report a size

decisions.q: Can the library calibrate size models?
decisions.why: 11 sized Au/Ag recipes across mixed methods; calibration must come from family recipes with outcomes
one-factor sweeps from open papers, blinded extraction

stages.summary: 7 one-factor sweeps from 4 open papers; 43 rows; two blinded readers agreed on all 139 shared numbers

decisions.why: values only one reader gave were dropped; real answers stay private
the predictor sees one point; the rest are sealed
Piella growth samples are one continuing batch (correlated); Piella pH/TA at 100 C; Dong sizes are UV-Vis (Haiss) estimates; Li NaOH sizes are histogram estimates

decisions.a: Wuithschick 2015, Dong 2020 ratio series, Babaei 2018, Zabetakis 2012
decisions.why: kept untouched as a held-out set for any model revised after seeing the scores

stages.summary: Continuum NP model (synthtwin.np): reduction kinetics, nucleation, growth, coalescence, capping; Mie optics; DLS. 0.1-0.5 s per prediction

decisions.why: fast enough for the optimiser; every parameter has a source or is marked assumed

decisions.q: Which parameters pass the MD/DFT gate?
decisions.why: sensitivity at default Au citrate (12.1 nm): coalescence off -> 6.4 nm; capping -0.6 eV -> 5.3 nm; gamma 0.4 -> 11.8 nm
no reliable reactive potential; ab initio MD in water far over budget; calibrated instead
EAM is adequate for bare Au/Ag; no ligand-water training data within the deadline

decisions.a: about 12.5 GPU-hours + 12 CPU core-hours, 2.6 h wall
decisions.why: LAMMPS EAM on 5 GPUs at low priority; no new DFT (literature values)

decisions.a: gamma size-independent (2-10 nm, within 1.3 %); every contact fuses
decisions.why: 196 Au/Ag dimer runs (1.5-8 nm, 300-550 K): full rounding within 2 ns only near 1.5 nm; Ag behaves like Au ~1 nm larger

decisions.a: physical gamma ~1.25 J/m2 vs default 0.3; coalescence_eff ~0.75 vs 0.02
decisions.why: the defaults stand in for burst nucleation and borohydride stabilisation rather than real surface energy and collision efficiency

tables.title: Atomistic values used by run B (Au, citrate, 348 K; +/- 1 sigma)
rows: Tyson-Miller 1977 + RPA/SCAN DFT, T and water corrections, MD size factor 1.00
EAM MD dimer rounding (lower bound; ns timescale)
Dinkel isotherms, published DFT adsorption energies

tables.title: MD/DFT gate decisions
rows: minutes per cluster; MD gives the size trend slabs miss
EAM MD of particle pairs vs size and T
vacuum MD ignores ligands: an upper bound, reported as such
published PBE/vdW adsorption energies; new ligand+water DFT would take days

stages.summary: Scores are private (computed against the vault); run the UI with --scores to see them

decisions.a: B helps if it beats A on MAE or trend_ok, or B0 beats A0
decisions.why: B0 vs A0 is the cleaner test of physics content
otherwise design candidates are labelled exploratory

stages.summary: Run this problem as a new study to see the live design step (calibrate, optimise, novelty, proposals)

decisions.why: best: ratio 1.6, 93 C, 0.40 mM -> predicted 16.6 nm, CV 9.2 % (outside the 8 nm target: exploratory)

stages.summary: A person approves each proposal (report: sources, calibration, validated vs exploratory, nearest recipe, assumptions)
Robot loop deferred: solution synthesis then UV-Vis and DLS; results return as recipes and new held-out sweeps

decisions.why: instrument drivers and plate formats come later

headline.text: Scores are private for now: the Benchmark stage shows the ablation design; the verdicts appear when the UI runs with the private score files.
